body.x: Qardio(www.getqardio.com), a technology company offering smart health solutions for the heart introduced QardioArm, QardioCore and other products at CES Unveiled, a pre-show of CES 2015 which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.QardioArm and QardioCore connects via wireless and integrates with iOS and Android devices. These devices make it easy and simple to monitor heart health regularly. Data are wirelessly and automatically transmitted to the Qardio app on your phone or tablet, and synched to Qardio’s secure cloud, where data is stored, analyzed and can be made available to a family member, physicians or healthcare providers. Health data are accessible at any point, on the iOS device. QardioArm and QardioCore are securely paired to the iOS device and ready to use in seconds, with the company's proprietary touch pairing technology. The Qardio app is available for free on iTunes App Store.
